sentences.en: We are still clinging to the dreams of our youth.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然紧抱着年轻时的梦想。

sentences.en: I have to wrap my sister's dinner in cling film.
sentences.zh: 我得把妹妹的晚餐用保鲜膜包起来。

sentences.en: What, then, is this? Distrust. Guard this, cling to this.
sentences.zh: 那么这是什么呢？是不信任。要小心，牢牢抓住这一点。

senses.zh: 抓住，抱紧；黏附，粘住；依恋，依附；坚持，坚信；紧抓不放，坚守
